Title: Treasure Hunt: Locate the stolen Gold and Silver
Descriptions: Listen carefully, %1! The instructions I'm about to pass are important if you want to help us return our stolen Gold & Silver. The thieves have split up the reserves into smaller shipments, and hidden them in shipping containers in 4 locations. Two are on the military airfields, one is on a military base in the East, and another is at the Takistani border at a check point to the West. We need to narrow down the locations more. Collect 3 morse code leaflets and bring them to me. One Leaflet has blood, one has coffee stains, and the other has been burned. Korvan Group Pilots have burned leaflets, Takistani Officers & Cultist Leaders have been seen carrying coffee stained leaflets, and Infected Officers at convoys may have the blood stained leaflets. Once you bring me all three types, I'll give you a key to open one of the containers. You can keep the loose bars as payment.
